title: Puharich first announces his Geller work at Zellerbach Auditorium
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Puharich first announces his Geller work at Zellerbach Auditorium, about 1972 at Berkeley, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and at Berkeley I sponsored a conference at in Zelerbach auditorium. 1,800 people showed up uh and Puharic was one of the speakers and it was at that conference that he made the very first public announcement about his work with Uri Geller
